title: Delta-triggered smoke and regression suites for model pin changes
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Design and implement a lightweight orchestrator that automatically runs targeted smoke tests and escalates to broader regression suites when a model version pin or a serving-config diff (catalog or customer-pinned) is detected. The goal is to provide near-immediate quality signals for catalog updates and customer lock changes without blocking normal rollouts, and to integrate with Console alerts and the rollout/rollback automation path.
acceptance_criteria: On a catalog model version update, the system automatically enqueues a smoke evaluation against a small representative prompt set within 5 minutes.

If smoke metrics cross any configured thresholds (e.g., response-quality delta > 3% or latency increase > 30ms), trigger a full regression run and raise a Console incident and Slack alert to the oncall channel.
For customer-pinned model changes, the smoke eval runs in the customers evaluation namespace and honors data residency controls; owner can opt-out per-customer.
Evaluation results are attached to the pin change event in Console with clear pass/fail and the top 5 example regressions and improvements.
Integrates with existing rollback automation: when a regression run fails and matches rollback criteria, the system creates a rollback proposal and attaches relevant diffs and eval artifacts.
The orchestrator exposes per-model and per-catalog metrics in Redwood Console (latency, top-line quality delta, sample failure rate) and stores artifacts in the eval storage bucket.
Runs are idempotent and can be re-triggered manually from the Console or via an API hook; run history is searchable by pin, catalog entry, and customer-id.
implementation_steps: Add a small delta-detector service that subscribes to pin events and config-change diffs (catalog and customer pin endpoints).
Define two evaluation profiles: 'smoke' (20-50 synthetic prompts, lightweight metrics) and 'full-regression' (full eval suite for the model).
Implement a policy engine to map diff severity and metric thresholds to actions: noop, smoke-only, full-run, alert, automatic-rollback-proposal.
Wire smoke runs to run on a low-priority batch pool to limit cost and avoid impacting real traffic in Dedicated clusters.
Store artifacts and results with links to sample inputs/outputs and metric deltas; add Console UI card that summarizes key deltas for a pin event.
Add customer opt-out/whitelist settings and ensure privacy controls for customer-pinned evals (no sensitive prompt retention).
Integrate Slack + PagerDuty notifications for failures exceeding critical thresholds and add a Console acknowledgement flow.
Add API endpoint for manual re-run and for consuming services to query eval status programmatically.
